Aldwyn Labs.

The Aldwyn studio website: a shared visual identity, service pages and a growing portfolio.

The brief

A home for the studio.

The website brings Aldwyn’s services and project work into one place. Built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, it uses a shared page system to carry the identity across the site.

The design direction

An identity with structure

The angular AL monogram informs the restrained geometric artwork. Aubergine and plum provide the setting, with iris used for emphasis and actions.

Space for the work

A landscape portfolio feature introduces the client sites. Individual project pages add context, screenshots and an explicit status.

A project planner

A short guided brief lets visitors organise their requirements and save a copy. The interface starts with the project itself and leaves additional details optional.

Project status

In progress

In development. The studio website and project planner are being refined before launch.
